designationHistory.indexText: Clarks River National Wildlife Refuge in western Kentucky was established in 1997 under the Emergency Wetlands Resources Act of 1986, after the refuge proposal was approved on June 19, 1997.
designationHistory.note: FWS only. The CCP gives the approval date (June 19, 1997) and 'Date Established: 1997'; the first acquisition date was not found.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Clarks River NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2012 (ServCat 168165)
